qa: No, you can't. Even if you have multiple Tamers with [Tai Kamiya] in their names, you can only return 1 card to the hand.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name, return 1 card with [Garurumon], [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name from your trash to the hand.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and another of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
